title: Book 1 — Clio, Chapter 48
paragraphs: Such, then, was the answer given to Croesus from Delphi. As for the answer of Amphiaraus, I cannot tell what he replied to the Lydians after they had performed the customary rites in his temple, for there is no record of this any more than of the others—except only that Croesus thought that he too possessed a true Oracle.
